required_fixes: Site selection must target genuine SPAs / client-side routed apps with non-leakage density >40% (hash routing, history API, form multi-step flows), not server-rendered MPAs (Wikipedia/MDN/GitHub) where <a href> encodes full destination URL and leakage 78-92% is structural. Current site corpus guarantees C7 failure even at 3-4x current raw N.

Fix data-collection throughput: resolve Playwright EPIPE on context.close in CI, increase trajectories to >=30 per site x 10-15 steps with spec delays (1.5s polite, 2.0s capture) to reach >=50 NL per site; 15x10 spec was not achieved (91/18/25 raw vs 150 expected per site).

Repair PMI pipeline conformance: run 1000 within-strata permutations per (URL, H_K=3, step) stratum as frozen; current analyze.py uses max(100, N*10)=100 perms on Wikipedia NL and global title shuffle not within-strata, violating spec measurement_validity 7-8 and null_control definition.

Repair negative control implementation: title-shuffled control must permute Title_before within (URL, H_K=3, step) strata (1000 per stratum) and pass criterion |BC|<3*std AND std>0; current global shuffle with std=0 makes PASS tautological and unsatisfied strictly (std=0 => fail). Do not report PASS when std=0.

Correct Bonferroni arithmetic: spec/prereg state 6 comparisons (3 sites x2 K) but threshold 0.0125 =0.05/4, while code uses 0.00833=0.05/6. Re-freeze consistent alpha and report both raw and Bonferroni p.

Address SA-sparsity degeneracy: with N=8 and 6 unique SA pairs (all singleton except 2 button self-loops), Laplace alpha=1.0 forces PMI=0 for any label; future designs must ensure denser revisits to same (URL, H_K) states or use alternative estimator / alpha sensitivity (0,0.5,2.0) before interpreting BC_PMI=0 as evidence.

Pre-register leakage handling for MPA vs SPA: exact target_href==state_after.url comparison over-classifies redirect/normalized URLs; add URL normalization (strip query/redirect tokens, decode) and action-type stratification (link_nav vs button_click) or SPA/MPA-specific C7 thresholds.

validity_findings.finding: Producer MEASUREMENT_INVALID is correctly assigned per frozen decision_rule: C7 requires >=50 NL on >=2/3 sites, observed 8/4/2 (0/3 pass). All other decision branches (SURVIVES, FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING, INCONCLUSIVE) correctly not taken. Outcome NOT_APPLICABLE is not falsification.

validity_findings.finding: High leakage (Wikipedia 91.2% 83/91, GitHub 77.8% 14/18, MDN 92.0% 23/25) is structural for server-rendered MPAs where href encodes destination. Recomputed from raw artifacts matches producer exactly. After filtering, NL subsets too small for PMI by design of site choice, not collection bug. Even with 450 raw transitions at 78% leakage, 50 NL would require ~227 raw at 78% and ~625 at 92%.

validity_findings.finding: Producer reports p=0.009901 (100 perms) but spec requires 1000 perms per (site,K) stratum within (URL,HK,step). analyze.py caps at 100 for N=8 (min(1000,max(100,N*10))) and run_experiment.py uses cross-trajectory shuffle across whole trajectories, while spec requires within-strata Title_before permutation. claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: No evidence for or against C-WEB-DYNAMICS title-aware conditional PMI on production server-rendered sites; MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to structural URL-level leakage (78-92% of link navigations have href==next URL) and SA-sparsity degeneracy (BC PMI 0.0, perm_std 0.0, H(NL)=0.0 on 8/4/2 NL transitions). Synthetic 8-state SPA positive control (BC 1.841 bits p=0.001) validates estimator on deterministic in-memory data only. Claim bounded to: server-rendered MPAs (Wikipedia/MDN/GitHub) with link-dominated Playwright navigation and exact href==URL leakage definition cannot express the tested effect at transition-level PMI with 50 NL threshold. No inference to production SPAs with client-side routing, hash/history navigation, form/button flows, or richer DOM/accessibility/visual state; synthetic-to-real gap remains the dominant unknown (30+ experiments synthetic).

unresolved: Whether production SPAs with hash/history client-side routing exhibit leakage <40% and yield >=50 NL transitions under same browser protocol (requires SPA corpus survey).
What action discovery fix (Playwright locator vs query_selector_all button:visible) and URL normalization would achieve action diversity >1 and valid within-strata permutation variance on real sites.

Whether PMI >0 would be detectable on NL subsets with denser sampling (repeated visits to same (URL,HK) states) or alternative alpha/estimator (Bayesian PMI, trajectory entropy rate) despite current SA-sparsity.
Whether title-aware PMI adds information beyond URL-only on server-rendered vs SPA sites where titles vary independently of URL (requires per-URL title variance >1, not just global 6 titles).
Whether Bonferroni threshold 0.0125 vs 0.00833 changes any future SURVIVES decision and whether prereg threshold should be re-frozen consistently.
